name: qlrisk_price_interest_rate_future
title: Price a InterestRateFuture
description:
Price one Interest Rate Future (qlrisk InterestRateFuture).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, rate_period_years=0.25 (years), index=SOFR, traded_price, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
